apply.description: Array of cell edits to apply

styleIndex.description: Index into the styles array to apply

value.description: Value or formula to write. Formulas start with "=". Omit to only apply style.

merge.description: Array of ranges to merge (e.g., ["A1:B2", "D4:E6"]). Each range must span at least 2 cells.

note.description: Description of this edit for version history

styles.description: Array of style objects referenced by styleIndex in apply items

fillColor.description: Cell background color as hex code

unmerge.description: Array of ranges to unmerge. Can specify exact merged range or any cell within a merge.

name: editCells
